mapper.sql: select a.id, a.name, a.phone, a.channel, a.ticket_type, a.company, a.email, a.attend_count, a.position, a.phone_tail4, a.import_batch, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.remark from kcon_attendee a

select a.id, a.name, a.phone, a.channel, a.ticket_type, a.company, a.email, a.attend_count, a.position, a.phone_tail4, a.import_batch, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.remark, c.port_no as port_no, case when c.id is null then 0 else 1 end as signed, date_format(c.checkin_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as checkin_time from kcon_attendee a left join kcon_checkin c on c.attendee_id = a.id
mapper.select: select a.id, a.name, a.phone, a.channel, a.ticket_type, a.company, a.email, a.attend_count, a.position, a.phone_tail4, c.port_no as port_no, case when c.id is null then 0 else 1 end as signed from kcon_attendee a left join kcon_checkin c on c.attendee_id = a.id where a.phone_tail4 = #{tail4} order by a.id
mapper.insert: insert into kcon_attendee (name, phone, channel, ticket_type, company, email, attend_count, position, phone_tail4, import_batch, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{name}, #{phone}, #{channel}, #{ticketType}, #{company}, #{email}, #{attendCount}, #{position}, #{phoneTail4}, #{importBatch}, #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})

insert into kcon_attendee (name, phone, channel, ticket_type, company, email, attend_count, position, phone_tail4, import_batch, create_by, create_time) values (#{name}, #{phone}, #{channel}, #{ticketType}, #{company}, #{email}, #{attendCount}, #{position}, #{phoneTail4}, #{importBatch}, #{createBy}, now()) on duplicate key update name = values(name), channel = values(channel), ticket_type = values(ticket_type), company = coalesce(values(company), company), email = coalesce(values(email), email), attend_count = coalesce(values(attend_count), attend_count), position = coalesce(values(position), position), phone_tail4 = values(phone_tail4), import_batch = values(import_batch), update_time = now()

mapper.select: select count(*) from kcon_checkin where checkin_date = curdate()

select a.company as company, count(*) as total, -- 「已签到」按当天口径，与 countSigned / 抽奖池一致（需求 FR-39） sum(case when c.id is null then 0 else 1 end) as signed from kcon_attendee a left join kcon_checkin c on c.attendee_id = a.id and c.checkin_date = curdate() where a.company is not null and a.company != '' group by a.company order by total desc limit #{limit}

select sum(case when attend_count = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as firstTime, sum(case when attend_count is not null and attend_count > 1 then 1 else 0 end) as returning, sum(case when attend_count is null then 1 else 0 end) as unknown from kcon_attendee
order by a.name asc, a.id asc
